planets.name: TOI-2345 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2345 with a 1.05-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-2345 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2345. Its orbit and size follow Eschen et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
